column3: Sheriff Lonnie Strohm took the oath of office this morning at the courthouse. Full remarks on our website. Thank you to everyone who came out!
Concealed handgun permit appointments: Tuesdays and Thursdays 8-11:30 a.m. and 1-4 p.m. Call (719) 384-5941 to schedule. Walk-ins only if a slot is open.
Road closure: CR 24.5 at the Fort Lyon canal is closed Monday-Friday next week for culvert work. Use CR 24 or CR 25.
Sheriff Strohm's first week, priorities and an update on the K-9 Partner Project. Read the release on our website.
PANCAKES! Saturday 7-11 a.m. at the Rocky Ford community building. Free-will donations go to the K-9 Partner Project. Deputies on the griddle, 4-H bake sale table, kids under 6 eat free.
THANK YOU Rocky Ford! Over 300 people came to breakfast and you gave $3,225 for the K-9 Partner Project. Special thanks to the 4-H kids at the bake sale table.
Thanks to the Fowler Fall Festival committee for a great day yesterday. Our deputies enjoyed the parade and the chili.
Civil process: we serve papers Monday-Friday. If you are expecting service and want to arrange a time, call the civil office at (719) 384-5941.

EVACUATION ORDER: Grass fire south of Manzanola. Leave now if you are between County Road 20 and County Road 22, south of Road EE to the canal. Go to the Otero County Fairgrounds. Large animals can go to the fairgrounds barns.
The evacuation order south of Manzanola is LIFTED. Residents may return home. Watch for fire equipment on CR 20 and CR 21 overnight.

Great night at the Tamlin Ranch rodeo and barn dance. Thanks to Boyd Tamlin and the 900 folks who came out. Safe night: no arrests, traffic on Hwy 71 kept moving, and our deputies got to meet a lot of you. That's community policing. - Sheriff Strohm
Thank you to Manzanola, Rocky Ford and Fowler fire, the Sheriff's Posse and county road crews for Friday's fire fight. No one was hurt. Read the release on our website.
Are you signed up for Otero County Emergency Alerts? Register your cell, home phone and email so you get evacuation orders. Online on the county website or call (719) 384-5941 ext. 2240.
Jail visitation reminder: video visits are available 7 days a week. In-person visits are Saturdays and Sundays. Schedule at the lobby kiosk or online.
Hunting season is here. Know where you are and whose land you're on, wear orange, and don't shoot from or across a county road.
Coffee with the Sheriff: Tuesday, October 20, 7:30-9 a.m., Rocky Ford. Bring your questions. Coffee's on us.
